subject: Clarifying artwork request
text:
Hi everyone,
Sorry if this arrives all out of order. I’m trying to clear up what we meant last week, because the note about final artwork could mean either the print files or just the mockups. I had assumed mockups, but now I think the print files might be the safer guess. Could someone confirm which one, and also whether the deadline moved after the call? If I’m still unclear, ignore this and remind me in simple terms tomorrow morning.
